# Starlyt

A documentation theme for Jigyll, using stock Starlight as its visual and responsive reference. Consumers use the shipped CSS and browser JavaScript; Node.js, Astro, and a Sass compiler are not required.

## Preview the living documentation

Prerequisites: Git and Jigyll 1.13.0 or later. Run these commands from this repository's root, in a checkout named `starlyt`:

```sh
jigyll new .poc/living-docs --theme "$PWD"
cp -R docs/site/. .poc/living-docs/
rm .poc/living-docs/404.html
jigyll serve --source .poc/living-docs --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4322
```

Open <http://127.0.0.1:4322/>. The first command is a one-time installation into a new target. It clones the committed theme through Jigyll's normal installer. The copy transfers only ordinary consumer Markdown, configuration, and content artwork—never layouts, includes, or theme assets. No custom runner or consumer preprocessing is involved.

The installer names the theme after the source checkout. If your checkout is not named `starlyt`, change `theme` in the copied consumer configuration to the name generated by the installer. Do not rename the tracked documentation configuration for a local preview.

## Edit and rebuild

`docs/site/` is the maintained source. `.poc/living-docs/` is a disposable installed consumer, not a second authoring location. After editing source pages, copy them again and build:

```sh
cp -R docs/site/. .poc/living-docs/
jigyll build --source .poc/living-docs
```

If the preview server is running, it watches the consumer files. Copying does not remove files: when a page is renamed or deleted, remove its obsolete copy from the disposable consumer too. The generated site is `.poc/living-docs/_site/`.

The installed theme is a Git snapshot, not a live link to uncommitted theme edits. After committing theme changes, update the installed checkout and restart the preview:

```sh
git -C .poc/living-docs/_theme/starlyt pull --ff-only
```

Use the actual installed theme directory if your checkout has a different name. Theme changes should be inspected through this installed consumer rather than by copying internal files into the site.

## Read or inspect

Start at the overview, then follow the guides for configuration, navigation, headings, Markdown, code, color modes, deployment, and internals. The manual-inspection page suggests interactions to try; it is not an automated test matrix. There is no maintained browser suite, screenshot comparison gate, or reference-generation workflow.

The documentation is a separate consumer: running `jigyll build` at the repository root is not the documentation build. The former root welcome scaffold has been replaced by the documentation overview.

See [the documentation source](docs/site/index.md) and [historical POC notes](docs/poc.md). The POC evidence is retained as history, not as a claim that the current site has complete visual parity or interaction parity with stock Starlight.

## Attribution

The theme retains upstream notices beside shipped third-party assets. Stock Starlight attribution is in `assets/starlight-LICENSE`, FlexSearch attribution is in `assets/flexsearch-LICENSE`, and the frozen Seti file-icon inventory is covered by `assets/file-tree-icons-LICENSE`.
